ms.report:
Milestone 1 - Proof of Achievement
A first PILOT was delivered as a 2hs workshop to nearly 200 students on November 8th at "Colegio de Estudios Superiores de Administración (CESA)" in Bogota Colombia, by Jose Gamboa.
A team of coordinators per country was established with: Jose Gamboa in Colombia, Mauro Andreoli in Argentina, Wilmer Varon in Venezuela and Cristian Rojas in México.
The curriculum was created with the following content (as it can be seen in the provided Draft Materials link - Slides):
Learning Objectives: 
2.1. General understanding of blockchain technology and its use cases. 
2.2. Understand what are the key components of a healthy Blockchain project.
2.3. Have an overview of opportunities in the blockchain space and how individuals and companies can get involved. 
Detailed list of topics: 
3.1. Blockchain use cases. What problem does it solve? 
3.2. What is a Blockchain and how it works. 
3.3. Consensus mechanisms and governance 
3.4. Smart Contracts 
3.5. Custody and wallets 
3.6. Opportunities 
Resources and reference materials
Several links on the presentation as well as a section (slide 68) dedicated to sources and references for those interested in more. 
Handouts: All the material will be accessible by students digitally. The only handout material that will be distributed physically will be a Cardano wallet creation guide
EVIDENCE

Draft Material Created and delivered: Slides and Material
